title: Ligand Effects in the Synthesis of Ln2+ Complexes by Reduction of Tris(cyclopentadienyl) Precursors Including C–H Bond Activation of an Indenyl Anion

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, THF (2 mL) was added to YCl3 (175 mg, 0.896 mmol). A pale yellow THF solution of NaCpMe (293 mg, 2.87 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred overnight. Insoluble material was removed by centrifugation, the supernatant was filtered, solvent was removed, and the product was extracted with toluene, filtered, and dried to give a pale yellow powder. Crystals were grown from toluene/hexane at −35 °C.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation, filtration, toluene extraction, and crystallization from toluene/hexane at −35 °C.

synthesis.procedure: In a coordinating-solvent-free glovebox, a toluene slurry of KCp (30 mg, 0.29 mmol, 5 mL) was added to a toluene slurry of Cp''2YI (160 mg, 0.252 mmol, 5 mL) and stirred overnight. Insoluble material was removed by centrifugation, the supernatant was filtered, solvent was removed, and the residue was extracted with hexane to give a waxy yellow solid whose NMR spectrum showed Cp''2YCp and Cp''YCp2 in an approximate 3:1 ratio. Recrystallization from hexane reversed the ratio to about 1:3.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation, filtration, hexane extraction; recrystallization from hexane changes the product ratio.

synthesis.procedure: Formed together with Cp''2YCp by addition of KCp (30 mg, 0.29 mmol) in toluene (5 mL) to Cp''2YI (160 mg, 0.252 mmol) in toluene (5 mL), overnight stirring, centrifugation, filtration, and hexane extraction. The initial waxy solid is about 3:1 Cp''2YCp:Cp''YCp2; recrystallization from hexane gives about 1:3, with Cp''YCp2 as the major NMR-observed product.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hexane extraction and recrystallization from hexane.

synthesis.procedure: Following the yttrium mixed-ligand procedure, KCp (17 mg, 0.165 mmol) was added to (Cp''2GdCl)2 (100 mg, 0.0820 mmol). Workup gave a waxy green-yellow solid used as a mixture of Cp''2GdCp and Cp''GdCp2; paramagnetism precluded NMR analysis.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same workup as the yttrium analog; mixture used as formed.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained as the companion product when KCp (17 mg, 0.165 mmol) was added to (Cp''2GdCl)2 (100 mg, 0.0820 mmol). The waxy green-yellow solid is a mixture of Cp''2GdCp and Cp''GdCp2 and was used as formed.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Mixture isolated and used without separation.

synthesis.procedure: Similar to the Cp''2YCp synthesis, NaCpMe (30 mg, 0.29 mmol) was added to Cp''2YI (158 mg, 0.249 mmol). Workup gave a yellow waxy solid that NMR showed to be an approximately 3:1 mixture of Cp''2YCpMe and Cp''YCpMe2.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as a waxy mixture and used without separation.

synthesis.procedure: Formed as the minor component of the approximately 3:1 mixture obtained from NaCpMe (30 mg, 0.29 mmol) and Cp''2YI (158 mg, 0.249 mmol).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Not separated from Cp''2YCpMe.

synthesis.procedure: Cp''2GdI was first prepared from GdI3(THF)3.5 (1.53 g, 1.93 mmol) and KCp'' (1.00 g, 4.03 mmol) as an off-white solid (1.11 g, 82%). NaCpMe (17 mg, 0.17 mmol) was then added to Cp''2GdI (100 mg, 0.142 mmol) by the mixed-ligand yttrium procedure to give a waxy green-yellow solid used as a mixture of Cp''2GdCpMe and Cp''GdCpMe2.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Mixture used as formed.
synthesis.yield: 75 mg of the mixture; Cp''2GdI precursor 1.11 g, 82%

synthesis.procedure: Present in the waxy mixture from NaCpMe (17 mg, 0.17 mmol) and Cp''2GdI (100 mg, 0.142 mmol); not separated from Cp''2GdCpMe.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Mixture used as formed.

synthesis.procedure: In an argon-filled glovebox, 88 mg of a 3:1 mixture of Cp''2YCp and Cp''YCp2 (approximately 70 mg, 0.12 mmol of Cp''2YCp) and 2.2.2-cryptand (58 mg, 0.15 mmol) were dissolved in Et2O (4 mL), cooled to −35 °C, and passed through a prechilled flash column of excess KC8. The dark-violet filtrate was layered with cold hexane (14 mL) and stored at −35 °C for 24 h. Black crystals for diffraction were grown from THF (4 mL) layered with hexane (14 mL). The crystal contains about 1.333 THF per formula unit.

reagents.name: Cp''2YCp/Cp''YCp2 mixture
reagents.amount: 88 mg mixture; about 70 mg, 0.12 mmol Cp''2YCp

synthesis.time: passage through the column in less than a minute; crystallization 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: argon glovebox, flash KC8 reduction column
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cold hexane layering at −35 °C; diffraction crystals from THF/hexane.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as a black microcrystalline solid; crystals from THF/hexane.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, THF (8 mL) was added to DyCl3 (324 mg, 1.21 mmol). A yellow THF solution (7 mL) of NaCpIn (500 mg, 3.62 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred overnight. After centrifugation and filtration, the yellow supernatant was stored at −35 °C in a vial fitted with an external NdFeB magnet. After 1 day, yellow crystals grew on the magnet side. An alternative route stirs KCpIn with DyCl3 overnight, removes solvent, washes with diethyl ether, and crystallizes the collected solid from THF.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glovebox; crystallization vial with external NdFeB magnet
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation and filtration, then crystallization from THF at −35 °C beside a magnet.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by addition of 3 equiv of NaCpIn or KCpIn to YCl3 in THF, analogously to the quantified DyCl3/NaCpIn procedure. The Y, Dy, and Ho adducts are isomorphous with the known Sm analog and crystallize in hexagonal space group P63. A separate fully quantified mass-scale procedure is given only for Dy.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Two crystal morphologies grow from the THF reaction mixture; one is the tris(indenyl) THF adduct.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by addition of 3 equiv of NaCpIn or KCpIn to HoCl3 in THF. With KCpIn, the solvated tris(indenyl) complex can be washed with diethyl ether and crystallized from THF. The Y, Dy, and Ho adducts crystallize in P63 and are isomorphous with the Sm analog. Masses are quantified in the main text only for the Dy reaction.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Ether wash and THF crystallization when KCpIn is used.

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from the mother liquor of the CpIn3Dy(THF) crystallization. That reaction used DyCl3 (324 mg, 1.21 mmol) in THF (8 mL) and NaCpIn (500 mg, 3.62 mmol) in THF (7 mL), stirred overnight, and was stored at −35 °C. The chloride-bridged byproduct was identified by X-ray crystallography (Figure 1).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Second crystalline species from the mother liquor of CpIn3Dy(THF).

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of 3 equiv of NaCpIn with YCl3 in THF deposits this NaCl-containing byproduct together with CpIn3Y(THF). It was identified by X-ray crystallography and is isomorphous with the Dy analog in Figure 1. Separate masses for the yttrium reaction are not given.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallized from the same THF reaction mixture as CpIn3Y(THF).

synthesis.procedure: CpIn3Dy(THF) can also be made by stirring KCpIn with DyCl3 overnight, removing solvent, and washing with diethyl ether. From that diethyl ether wash, crystals of [CpIn2Dy(μ-Cl)2K(Et2O)]∞ were isolated and identified by X-ray crystallography (Figure 2). No numerical reagent amounts are given for this KCpIn route.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals isolated from the diethyl ether wash.

synthesis.procedure: When KCpIn is used with HoCl3, diethyl ether washing of the tris(indenyl) product also gives crystals of [CpIn2Ho(μ-Cl)2K(Et2O)]∞, identified by X-ray crystallography and isomorphous with the Dy polymer in Figure 2. No numerical amounts are reported for this isolation.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals from the diethyl ether wash.

material_class.structural_family: triangular μ3-oxo μ3-chloride indenyl holmium cluster

synthesis.procedure: In the holmium indenyl synthesis, a sodium-free trimetallic chloro-oxide complex, [CpInHo(THF)]3(μ-Cl)3(μ3-Cl)(μ3-O), crystallized from the NaCpIn route that was subjected to an ether-wash workup analogous to the KCpIn procedure. It was identified by X-ray crystallography (Figure S4). The main text names HoCl3 and NaCpIn but does not give a numerical amount, time, or yield for this cluster.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals isolated from the ether-wash method and identified crystallographically.

synthesis.procedure: 2.2.2-Cryptand (47 mg, 0.13 mmol) was added to a yellow THF (10 mL) solution of CpIn3Dy(THF) (72 mg, 0.12 mmol). KC8 (50 mg, 0.37 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for 3 min. Black solids were filtered off, the dark brown filtrate was concentrated to 2 mL, and the vial was fitted with an external NdFeB magnet. After several days at −35 °C, pale tan crystals grew near the magnet. The Table 1 empirical formula includes additional THF relative to the two cryptand cations and the Dy2 anion.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glovebox; vial with external NdFeB magnet
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, concentration to 2 mL, and crystallization at −35 °C near a magnet.
